items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: Yeah, well that trombone player, he got inside Jim Robinson and played.

ctx.x: Well that was supposed to be an amateur contest, you know? Oh it was an amateur contest. Yeah, and they were supposed to be the best amateur band.
Yeah, well that trombone player, he got inside Jim Robinson and played. I'm telling you, he wasn't nothing stopping him.
And let's see, Chris Balba played with you all in Washington. That's right, when we first got there, remember? Yeah. Or when they first got there, at the Coliseum, I think they came up.
